title: Balkansky – BRAT (from “Orenda” album)
author: Mart Kawaii
body_html:
I’m always happy to see and share good Bulgarian folklore-inspired production with a great visual realization. The new Balkansky video is exactly that – Ivan Shopov (also known with his other DnB project COOH) and one of the well-known worldwide Bulgarian kaval virtuoso Teodosii Spasov reunite its forces to create this modern high-class composition. The arrangement and the conception are done by Ivo Christov, while ADDMINIMAL Creative Studio is responsible for the sleek video production.

Now there is something to really be proud of.

The video just got uploaded online today and I’m sure you’ll hear more and more about it.

Now watch. And listen.

 

You can listen to the full album “Orenda” here for free or purchase it for your collection.

Good job, guys! I’m impressed.
